GRADE 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Relationship at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Relationship using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Relationship completely.
   C. Relationship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Relationship.

2. About Relationship at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Relationship at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Relationship completely.
   C. Relationship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Relationship.

3. About Relationship when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Relationship helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Relationship completely.
   C. Relationship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Relationship.

5. About Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals completely.
   C. Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

6. About Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals completely.
   C. Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

7. About Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals completely.
   C. Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

9. About Milad un-Nabi at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
   B. Learners should ignore Milad un-Nabi completely.
   C. Milad un-Nabi is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Milad un-Nabi.

10. About Milad un-Nabi at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
   B. Learners should ignore Milad un-Nabi completely.
   C. Milad un-Nabi is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Milad un-Nabi.

11. About Milad un-Nabi when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
   B. Learners should ignore Milad un-Nabi completely.
   C. Milad un-Nabi is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Milad un-Nabi.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Relationship at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Milad un-Nabi at home with your family.
